summary: integrations post-slack-settings takes typed --channel and --notify-events flags (board #578; app route changed under small563). A flag that was not passed is not sent (keep); an explicit empty value (--notify-events "" or =, --channel "") is sent as [] / "" via Changed() (clear); Long states keep / clear / 400; --stdin passes the body through untouched and reads cmd.InOrStdin(). spec.yaml and upstream/openapi.yaml carry the live typed requestBody. Prose note: .printing-press-patches/slack-settings-typed-body-578.md. Since reprint 637 both files are the whole live document.
reason: The generated command was printed from the untyped body, so it offered only --stdin; a reprint from the untyped spec, or a hand edit that drops Changed(), would silently send nothing or drop the explicit empty list, which the API reads as clear-every-event.
validated_outcome: Wire body is exactly the flags passed ({}, {channel}, {notifyEvents:[]} for an explicit empty value, both); --stdin bodies (including a non-array notifyEvents) reach the API unchanged for its 400; spec.yaml and upstream/openapi.yaml requestBody are deep-equal and typed; TestSpecMatchesUpstreamPublicAPI, go build, go test ./... and go vet pass.
upstream_issue: None: the generator already emits typed flags from a typed body; only Long, the Changed()-gated empty-list send and InOrStdin are local.
